title: Create NewProjectWizard.tsx TUI component
description: Create the main Ink TUI component for the 'rocket new' wizard. Shows step-by-step prompts for project type selection and optional feature toggles. Uses SelectInput for list choices.
acceptanceCriteria: Component renders project type selection (Web App | Website)
Selecting Web App shows feature toggle sub-steps (auth, email, PDF renderer)
Component uses SelectInput from ink-select-input for list choices
After all selections, calls an onComplete callback with the configuration

steps.details: Create src/tui/components/NewProjectWizard.tsx. Import React, Box, Text from ink, SelectInput from ink-select-input. Define state: { step: 'type' | 'features' | 'done', type: 'webapp' | 'website' | null, features: { auth: boolean, email: boolean, pdf: boolean } }

When step === 'type', render: <Box flexDirection='column'><Text bold>Select project type:</Text><SelectInput items={[{label:'Web App (React + Express)', value:'webapp'},{label:'Website (PHP + MySQL)', value:'website'}]} onSelect={(item) => handleTypeSelect(item.value)} /></Box>

steps.description: Implement feature toggle steps for Web App
steps.details: When step === 'features' and type === 'webapp', show sequential yes/no prompts for auth, email, and PDF renderer. Each uses SelectInput with [{label:'Yes',value:true},{label:'No',value:false}]. Advance through sub-steps.
After all steps complete, call props.onComplete({ type, features }). The parent command handler will use this data to call scaffold().

technicalNotes: SelectInput renders options as a list — use flexDirection: 'column' in the parent Box
Ink's rendering is synchronous within the component tree — state updates trigger re-renders automatically
